result.instructions: Tools for Yuki, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which sales invoices are still open, and which are past their due date?"; "Show the balance of every ledger account of my company on 31 December."; "What was my net revenue in the third quarter?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Yuki data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run yuki_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run yuki_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run yuki_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. yuki_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: yuki_list_domains
tools.title: List domains
tools.description: List the Yuki domains (customer environments) this access key can reach: id, name and URL. Accountant keys reach many domains. Accounting.Domains.

offset.description: Skip this many items (default 0). Use the previous reply's next_offset to read on.

tools.name: yuki_list_administrations
tools.title: List administrations
tools.description: List the administrations (companies with their own books) this access key can reach: id, name, address, Chamber of Commerce and VAT numbers, start date. Use the ids in the other tools. Accounting.Administrations.

offset.description: Skip this many items (default 0). Use the previous reply's next_offset to read on.

tools.name: yuki_list_outstanding_debtor_items
tools.title: List open sales invoices (debtors)
tools.description: Open items on the debtors list (unpaid sales invoices): date, description, contact, open and original amount, reference, due date. Optionally within a date range. Accounting.OutstandingDebtorItems / OutstandingDebtorItemsByDate.

administration_id.description: Yuki administration id (from yuki_list_administrations). Optional when the key has a single administration.

include_bank_transactions.description: Also list unmatched bank transactions as open items (default false).

start_date.description: With end_date: only items dated in this range (yyyy-mm-dd).

end_date.description: With start_date: end of the range (yyyy-mm-dd).

offset.description: Skip this many items (default 0). Use the previous reply's next_offset to read on.

tools.name: yuki_list_outstanding_creditor_items
tools.title: List open purchase invoices (creditors)
tools.description: Open items on the creditors list (unpaid purchase invoices): date, description, contact, open and original amount, reference, due date. Optionally within a date range. Accounting.OutstandingCreditorItems / OutstandingCreditorItemsByDate.

administration_id.description: Yuki administration id (from yuki_list_administrations). Optional when the key has a single administration.

include_bank_transactions.description: Also list unmatched bank transactions as open items (default false).

start_date.description: With end_date: only items dated in this range (yyyy-mm-dd).

end_date.description: With start_date: end of the range (yyyy-mm-dd).

offset.description: Skip this many items (default 0). Use the previous reply's next_offset to read on.

tools.name: yuki_get_gl_account_balance
tools.title: Get general ledger balances
tools.description: The balance of every general ledger account of an administration on a date (yyyy-mm-dd): account code, description, amount. Accounting.GLAccountBalance.

administration_id.description: Yuki administration id (from yuki_list_administrations). Optional when the key has a single administration.

offset.description: Skip this many items (default 0). Use the previous reply's next_offset to read on.

tools.name: yuki_list_gl_account_transactions
tools.title: List general ledger transactions
tools.description: The transactions booked on one general ledger account in a date range: date, description, amount, contact, project. Get account codes from yuki_get_gl_account_scheme. Accounting.GLAccountTransactions.

administration_id.description: Yuki administration id (from yuki_list_administrations). Optional when the key has a single administration.

offset.description: Skip this many items (default 0). Use the previous reply's next_offset to read on.

tools.name: yuki_get_net_revenue
tools.title: Get net revenue
tools.description: The net revenue (turnover) of an administration in a date range, by transaction date. Accounting.NetRevenue.

administration_id.description: Yuki administration id (from yuki_list_administrations). Optional when the key has a single administration.

tools.name: yuki_get_gl_account_scheme
tools.title: Get chart of accounts
tools.description: The general ledger accounts (chart of accounts) of an administration: code, description, type. Use the codes in yuki_list_gl_account_transactions. AccountingInfo.GetGLAccountScheme.

administration_id.description: Yuki administration id (from yuki_list_administrations). Optional when the key has a single administration.

offset.description: Skip this many items (default 0). Use the previous reply's next_offset to read on.

tools.name: yuki_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: Projects of an administration (code, description, company, contact, period, budgets), optionally filtered. AccountingInfo.GetProjects.

administration_id.description: Yuki administration id (from yuki_list_administrations). Optional when the key has a single administration.

search_value.description: Text to search for (ignored for All).

offset.description: Skip this many items (default 0). Use the previous reply's next_offset to read on.

tools.name: yuki_search_contacts
tools.title: Search contacts
tools.description: Search the contacts (customers and suppliers) of a domain by name, city, postcode, tag, email, website, phone, code, Chamber of Commerce number, VAT number or bank account. Returns at most 100 contacts per page; ask for the next page_number until the reply is empty. Contact.SearchContacts.

domain_id.description: Yuki domain id (from yuki_list_domains). Optional when the key has a single domain.

search_value.description: Text to search for. Empty lists all contacts.

page_number.description: Page number, starting at 1 (default 1). A page holds up to 100 contacts.

offset.description: Skip this many contacts of the page (default 0). A long page is cut to fit the reply: use next_offset with the same page_number, then the next page_number.

tools.name: yuki_list_document_folders
tools.title: List archive folders
tools.description: The folders of the document archive (id, name). With an accountant key that reaches several domains, pass domain_id so the archive of that domain is read (default: the key's only domain). Archive.DocumentFolders.

domain_id.description: Yuki domain id (from yuki_list_domains). Optional when the key has a single domain.

tools.name: yuki_list_document_folder_tabs
tools.title: List archive folder tabs
tools.description: The tabs inside one archive folder (id, name). Archive.DocumentFolderTabs.

domain_id.description: Yuki domain id (from yuki_list_domains). Optional when the key has a single domain.

tools.name: yuki_list_documents
tools.title: List archive documents
tools.description: Documents in the archive (invoices, receipts, bank statements...) with id, subject, type, contact, dates, amount. Narrow by archive folder or by document type, and by creation date range. Page with number_of_records and start_record. Archive.Documents / DocumentsInFolder / DocumentsByType.

folder_id.description: Only this archive folder (id from yuki_list_document_folders). Not together with document_type.

document_type.description: Only this Yuki document type number. Not together with folder_id.

start_record.description: Offset of the first document (default 0). Add numberOfRecords to page on.

offset.description: Skip this many documents of the fetched batch (default 0). A long batch is cut to fit the reply: use next_offset with the same arguments.

domain_id.description: Yuki domain id (from yuki_list_domains). Optional when the key has a single domain.

tools.name: yuki_search_documents
tools.title: Search archive documents
tools.description: Search archive documents by text in the creator, contact, subject, tag or type (or all). Optionally limit to a folder or tab and a date range. Archive.SearchDocuments.

folder_id.description: Only this folder; -1 or omitted = all folders.

tab_id.description: Only this tab; -1 or omitted = all tabs.

start_date.description: First day, yyyy-mm-dd. Omit with end_date to search all years.

start_record.description: Offset of the first document (default 0). Add numberOfRecords to page on.

offset.description: Skip this many documents of the fetched batch (default 0). A long batch is cut to fit the reply: use next_offset with the same arguments.

domain_id.description: Yuki domain id (from yuki_list_domains). Optional when the key has a single domain.

tools.name: yuki_get_document
tools.title: Get document
tools.description: Details of one archive document by id (subject, type, contact, dates, amounts, folder). Archive.FindDocument.

document_id.description: Yuki document id (the ID in a document list).

domain_id.description: Yuki domain id (from yuki_list_domains). Optional when the key has a single domain.

tools.name: yuki_get_document_download_url
tools.title: Get document download link
tools.description: A presigned download URL for the file of one archive document (the link works for a short time; open it in a browser). Archive.DocumentDownloadUrl.

document_id.description: Yuki document id (the ID in a document list).

domain_id.description: Yuki domain id (from yuki_list_domains). Optional when the key has a single domain.
